fields.description: 2026-08-29: per-item settlement, so a batch can be partially paid (some applicants paid, some still owed) rather than all-or-nothing. 'Released' means this unpaid item was carried out of this batch into a later one (finance_api.release_unpaid_items) -- it stays here for history but no longer counts toward this batch's total.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Set when this item was carried over from a prior batch's unpaid item (trace-back to where the commission was first requested).
fields.label: Carried From Batch
